counting_unit: retained IP–canonical-torrent memberships over the cumulative period
limitations: IP geolocation points describe network locations, not stadium attendance or verified residence.
A membership may repeat across torrents and roles; per-capita rates are not download prevalence.
Mexico uses a compatible 2020 census population/boundary pair; USA and Canada use July 2025 population estimates.
Nationally defined metropolitan areas differ in construction across countries.
Population normalization does not control internet access, urbanization, torrent supply, hosting or VPNs.
Sampling starts June 29, during the Round of 32; there is no pre-tournament causal baseline.
